output.rationale: The requirement specifies a 15kV two-section metal-clad switchgear lineup. The product 'CROWN-ARMV' from the CROWN business unit is an engineered-to-order (ETO) solution that provides metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear lineups, including 15kV configurations, meeting the technical specifications such as arc-resistant construction and vacuum circuit breakers. This aligns well with the requirement.
